title: Single-stage overlap comparison data
statement: For the fixed two-open overlap, supplied local identifications, and any one later index k≥j, comparison data of the prescribed type exists at that stage.

source.place: Tag 09RE, restriction of perfect complexes and derived pullback along the affine limit system.

proof.text: For each open W, construct the comparison between derived pullback followed by exact restriction and exact restriction followed by pullback along resLE. Replace exact restriction by derived pullback along the open inclusion, apply the fixed pullback composition comparisons and the equality resLE followed by the inclusion equals the original map restricted to the source open. Compose with the derived inverse open-site equivalence; its unit gives the site-return comparison.

Define HU, HV and HW to be pullback along the three restricted maps followed by the inverse derived open-site equivalences. The preceding comparisons give betaU, betaV and betaW. Exact open restriction is a localization. Fully faithful precomposition therefore lifts the global composites betaU inverse, tauU, betaW and alphaU inverse to gammaU, and similarly gives gammaV. The map_preimage identity followed by cancellation proves both coherence equations on every global object.

For composable maps g,f with composite gf, restrict g to the inverse-image opens of gf. The restricted composite with f is gf restricted to the original open, as can be checked after the monomorphism of that open. Whisker the fixed derived-pullback composition isomorphism with the inverse site equivalence to obtain kappaU and kappaV. Define thetaU and thetaV as kappa followed by the image of phi and the site-return comparison. Their two defining equations hold by reflexivity.

For the finite-stage and apex base-change maps, the cocone equation gives equality of the composite Over arrows with the direct arrow. Functoriality of baseChangeMap gives g followed by f equals gj. Apply the construction for composable maps to obtain the prescribed single-stage comparison data. This uses no compactness, perfectness, covering, finite-presentation or Hom-continuity argument beyond the unchanged input types.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean construction from the canonical open-pullback and composition comparisons. Localization of exact open restriction lifts the two overlap comparison isomorphisms, so their coherence is proved by map_preimage and cancellation. No new sorry or arbitrary existence witness is introduced.
